content.text:
The vendor added one column, `network_status`, at the end of the header. All 5 rows hold `IN` with no empties, and every declared column still passes its rules.
The contract now declares `network_status` as a required string with `allowed: [IN]` and bumps the version from 1 to 2. Nothing is loosened.
The dry run accepted 5 rows and rejected 0. The proposal is pending approval as approval 1, and a person must review it before it becomes a branch to publish.
